test_experiments_registry: test the experiments registry by validating each experiment maker for coherence and determinism
test_groups_registry: test the optimizer groups registry by verifying all optimizers are properly registered
check_maker: check an experiment maker generator for determinism and non-randomness across multiple iterations
check_experiment: check the seedability of an experiment maker by running with identical and different seeds
recorder_fixture: record optimizer groups during test execution and write results to optimizer_groups.txt
